name: Pybromazolam
dosageRemark: The oral dose bands and duration are transcribed from FreeODwiki. The page labels its toxicity section a stub that may contain dangerous errors, so these community-derived figures and risk descriptions are low-confidence reference data, not recommendations.
generalRisks: Combining benzodiazepines with opioids, alcohol, or other depressants may cause fatal overdose. It also warns that abrupt withdrawal after regular use may be life-threatening. The page marks its toxicity section as incomplete.
addictionPotential: Strong physical and psychological dependence potential; the page's toxicity section is marked as an incomplete stub, so treat this as low-confidence source information.
toxicities: Combining with opioids, alcohol, or other depressants may cause life-threatening respiratory depression.
Abrupt withdrawal after regular use may cause seizures or death.

tolerance.full: Tolerance to sedative effects is reported to develop within days of continuous use.

saferUse: Regular users should not stop suddenly; gradual dose reduction may be needed.
